scope: Continued investigation of two pinned runtime mismatches using structural diagnostics, preserved object inputs and controlled link replays. Exact resource hashes, sizes and direct byte comparisons determine runtime equality independently of diagnostic normalization.

collector.scope: The recorded datasets bind their actual collector source bytes. Later formatting preserves analysis semantics, and the current CLI creates output exclusively with alias/existing-file regressions. Complete numeric operands support subsequent analysis without serializing function body bytes.

canonicalizationScope.referenceFingerprint: Preserves the function signature, instruction opcodes, locals, branch depths, memory operands, constants and literal float bits. Replaces function references with their parameter/result signatures, type indices with signatures, and global references with value type/mutability. Function and global identity within the same signature/type can merge under this normalization.
canonicalizationScope.layoutFingerprint: Applies reference normalization and replaces i32.const values within the module's initialized data address span and load/store offsets within that span with address markers. Other integer constants and memory offsets are preserved. Numeric values within that span can merge with addresses under this normalization.
canonicalizationScope.opcodeShapeFingerprint: Preserves the function signature, local declarations and instruction opcode sequence, including extended subopcodes, block types and call/global type signatures. Drops other immediates. Functions with different constants, branch targets or operand indices can merge under this normalization.
canonicalizationScope.operandMetadata: Per-function integerConstants and functionReferences are complete numeric triples [zero-based instruction ordinal, opcode, value or function index]. indirectReferences are [ordinal, opcode, type index, table index]. Ordinals count decoded instructions after local declarations. Unsupported instructions make operandMetadataComplete false.
canonicalizationScope.purpose: Diagnostic correspondence hints. Exact resource and body byte comparisons remain independent of these fingerprints.
canonicalizationScope.unsupportedInstructions: An unsupported instruction leaves both canonical fingerprints unavailable for that function and records its opcode and byte offset. Its exact body fingerprint remains available.

effectiveHeapAuditCorrection.scope: Audit correction of requested Make MEMORY argument versus effective pinned frontend INITIAL_HEAP and actual WASM memory. Runtime bytes and the original recorded commands are preserved.

attribution.scope: Positive function-name provenance. Link-map metadata options preserve exact preoptimizer bytes. Each names-only Binaryen replay reads its original checkpoint and preserves every serialized noncustom section. Later generated names refer to zero-based defined input function ordinals. Duplicate map names retain ambiguous ownership; missing names give no exclusion claim.

findings: Pinned Binaryen ReorderFunctions sorts by static call/export/element use counts and descending function names. Final function indices interleave object ownership.
Changed-address joins give original relative BSS constraints for 36 core owner groups, including shared.o before rand.o and rearranged game groups.

Pinned history adds rand.c during the 2020 game/player/monster refactor, which also renames objects. These observations leave the historical full 167-member archive order and cache identity unresolved.

hostedRun.scope: Both original resource pins and dated archive pin are verified before runner-side direct comparisons. Local analysis verifies every captured source/header snapshot and command/log hash. Runtime outputs are compared on the runner.

unmatchedStructuralPatterns.attributionScope: Indices and numeric operand metadata identify structural differences. Object/source ownership of these patterns remains unresolved.

javascriptDifference.scope: Bounded comparison of every reported aligned JavaScript differing span. All30 differing bytes are covered by these spans.

captureVerification.scope: Local verification of every hosted command record, compiler input snapshot, manifest and command log pin. New source/header path/hash/size tuples and runtime resource comparison results are compared with the previous corrected Linux recipe.
